blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Port Moody Centre is the south-shore centre of Port Moody, around two SkyTrain stations: Moody Centre Station on the St. Johns Street corridor and Inlet Centre Station at Barnet Highway and Ioco Road.
The City's Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw No.

The Moody Centre Station transit-oriented development area currently extends from the Canadian Pacific Railway line to St. Johns Street and from Electronic Avenue to Moody Street, with the station as its focal point.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The centre's house stock is the detached streets south of St. Johns Street, under the RS zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 2937, while the RT and RM zones carry the townhouse and apartment stock and the TC and CRM zones the mixed-use stock around the stations.
Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, so the older house stock here carries heritage rules the newer suburbs do not.
Rocky Point Park, with its pier, boat launch, pool and the start of the Shoreline Trail, is the centre's waterfront anchor.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The RS1-S small-lot rezoning route is available in Moody Centre's single-family low-density areas, with minimums of 9 metres width and 325 square metres — the small-lot option the west-end neighbourhoods do not have.

Transit-oriented areas are exempt from the small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules, and SSMUH applies in the RS and RT zones outside them, so a centre lot's position relative to the station areas decides which regime governs it.
Because Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, a heritage alteration permit may be required for work on a house here.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Moody Centre Station is a three-mode station: SkyTrain on the Millennium Line, the West Coast Express commuter rail, and a bus loop share the one St. Johns Street corridor site.

The combined Inlet Centre and Coronation Park area extends from Noons Creek Drive to Murray Street, and from St. Johns Street and Barnet Highway to the Coquitlam municipal border, so the centre's east side runs to another city's line.
Johns Special Study Area, Westport Village, the Heritage Commercial District and the Oceanfront District — so a centre address's rules depend on which part it falls in.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Port Moody property taxes are set city-wide, and the speculation and vacancy tax applies in Port Moody, so owners declare annually.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: getting around

items.t: Moody Centre Station (SkyTrain, West Coast Express and bus loop) and Inlet Centre Station are the centre's two stations, on the Millennium Line, with the West Coast Express running between downtown Vancouver and Mission on weekdays in the morning and evening rush.
St. Johns Street and Barnet Highway (Highway 7A) are the centre's east–west corridors, and the Shoreline Trail starts at Rocky Point Park on the waterfront.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check heritage status before planning work: Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area and a heritage alteration permit may be required.
Confirm whether the lot sits inside a transit-oriented area, because those areas are exempt from the SSMUH rules that apply elsewhere in the centre.
Confirm the SD43 catchment for the exact address, since two school chains serve central Port Moody.

blocks.text: Port Moody Centre home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre with a median price of $1,390,000 (the middle half sold between $1,292,500 and $1,915,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $570 per square foot, a median year built of 1969 and a median lot of 7,824 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Port Moody Centre. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Port Moody Centre had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Port Moody Centre from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Can a centre house lot be split into small lots?
faq.a: The RS1-S small-lot rezoning is available in Moody Centre's single-family low-density areas, at minimums of 9 metres width and 325 square metres, which is the small-lot route the City offers here and in Seaview and Pleasantside but not in College Park or Glenayre.

faq.q: What civic facilities are in the centre?
faq.a: The Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road, Kyle Centre at 125 Kyle Street and the Port Moody Public Library at 100 Newport Drive, and Rocky Point Park holds the pier, boat launch, pool and Shoreline Trail start on the waterfront.

faq.q: Does the heritage conservation area affect a house purchase?
faq.a: Yes: Moody Centre is a heritage conservation area, so a heritage alteration permit may be required for alterations, and buyers of older houses here should check the permit position before planning exterior work.

faq.q: What did houses in Port Moody Centre sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Port Moody Centre between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,390,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
